_comment: Authoritative web search / grounding pricing from provider documentation. Source: /opt/acm2/docs/WEB_SEARCH_BILLING_GUIDE.md. This supplements pricing_index.json (OpenRouter) which lacks native web search costs.

searchbox._doc: APICostX Searchbox floor pricing. Each AIQ Searchbox web-search request is at least 0.001 cent, which is $0.00001 USD per search.

web_search.notes: Internal Searchbox floor price; richer Searchbox usage metadata may raise the final search cost in a later implementation. The floor prevents AIQ Searchbox calls from being recorded as unknown or free.

google._doc: Google has TWO billing models: per-grounded-prompt (2.5 and older) vs per-query (3.x). Prices are per-unit, NOT per-1k.

per_grounded_prompt.notes: Flat fee per API request that returns grounding supports. Multiple queries per prompt still = 1 billable unit.

per_query.notes: Each individual search query is billed separately. 5,000 free queries/month. Deep Research query count is estimated at 160/task.

anthropic._doc: Anthropic charges $10 per 1,000 web searches ($0.01/search). Failed searches are not billed. Search content tokens are included in input_tokens at the model input rate.

web_search.notes: Each server_tool_use.web_search_requests = 1 billable search. Search content tokens billed at model input rate. Failed searches are NOT billed.

openai._doc: OpenAI charges per tool call + search content tokens at model input rate. The per-call fee varies by tool type and model category.

web_search.notes: Each web_search_call output item = 1 billable tool call. search content tokens billed at model input rate.

web_search_preview_non_reasoning.notes: Higher per-call rate but search content tokens are NOT charged.
